credential-attacks.name: Authentication Risk - Brute Force / Credential Stuffing
credential-attacks.detection_signal: Repeated 401 or 403 responses from one source
credential-attacks.fix: Rate-limit attempts, revoke exposed sessions, reset credentials, and require MFA.
credential-attacks.precaution: Monitor account and source velocity and use breached-password screening.

route-scanning.name: Reconnaissance / Route Scanning
route-scanning.fix: Block or challenge the source and inspect subsequent exploit attempts.
route-scanning.precaution: Minimize route disclosure and alert on concentrated 404 activity.

sql-injection.name: SQL Injection Attempt
sql-injection.detection_signal: SQL control syntax in request evidence
sql-injection.fix: Use parameterized queries, isolate affected credentials, and review database logs.
sql-injection.precaution: Use least-privilege database roles and regression-test every input path.

cross-site-scripting.name: Cross-Site Scripting Attempt
cross-site-scripting.detection_signal: Executable markup or browser event handlers in input
cross-site-scripting.fix: Apply contextual output encoding, sanitization, CSP, and session invalidation.
cross-site-scripting.precaution: Use escaping-by-default templates and test stored, reflected, and DOM inputs.

path-traversal.name: Path Traversal Attempt
path-traversal.fix: Canonicalize and allow-list paths and rotate exposed secrets.
path-traversal.precaution: Map opaque identifiers to server-side paths and restrict filesystem permissions.

command-injection.name: Command Injection Attempt
command-injection.detection_signal: Shell metacharacters or process invocation indicators
command-injection.fix: Remove shell invocation, isolate the host, and rotate host secrets.
command-injection.precaution: Use native APIs, strict argument allow-lists, and low-privilege services.

denial-of-service.name: Denial of Service Signal
denial-of-service.detection_signal: Concentrated request volume with 429 or 503 responses
denial-of-service.fix: Enable edge rate limits, challenges, and capacity protection.
denial-of-service.precaution: Cap expensive work and reserve capacity for authenticated traffic.

operational-failure.name: Operational Risk
operational-failure.fix: Inspect stack traces, dependencies, and recent deployments.
operational-failure.precaution: Use health checks, staged releases, and error-budget alerts.

performance-degradation.name: Performance Risk
performance-degradation.detection_signal: Response time exceeds the service threshold
performance-degradation.fix: Profile the endpoint and inspect downstream dependencies.
performance-degradation.precaution: Set latency SLOs, tracing, and bounded timeouts.

frontend-runtime.name: Frontend Runtime Risk
frontend-runtime.fix: Reproduce the error, inspect source maps, and patch unsafe data handling.
frontend-runtime.precaution: Deploy CSP and frontend exception monitoring.

security-warning.name: Warning
security-warning.detection_signal: Error, critical, or fatal application severity
security-warning.fix: Review the event in context and preserve related evidence.
security-warning.precaution: Use structured severity policy and correlation alerts.

server-side-request-forgery.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
server-side-request-forgery.detection_signal: Requests targeting private, loopback, or metadata addresses
server-side-request-forgery.fix: Block the request and rotate any exposed workload credentials.
server-side-request-forgery.precaution: Allow-list destinations, revalidate redirects, and restrict egress.

phishing.name: Phishing
phishing.detection_signal: Look-alike domains or unexpected authentication after a lure
phishing.fix: Revoke sessions, reset credentials, and remove malicious messages.
phishing.precaution: Use phishing-resistant MFA, DMARC, and user reporting workflows.

ransomware.name: Ransomware
ransomware.detection_signal: Mass file changes, backup deletion, or security-tool tampering
ransomware.fix: Isolate affected systems and restore from verified immutable backups.
ransomware.precaution: Segment networks, protect admin paths, and rehearse restoration.

data-exfiltration.name: Data Exfiltration
data-exfiltration.detection_signal: Unusual outbound volume or sensitive-object access
data-exfiltration.fix: Contain the account or host and preserve transfer evidence.
data-exfiltration.precaution: Classify data, restrict egress, and alert on abnormal transfer volume.

privilege-escalation.name: Privilege Escalation
privilege-escalation.detection_signal: Unexpected role, token, or privileged-process change
privilege-escalation.fix: Revoke elevated access, isolate the asset, and remediate the exploited path.
privilege-escalation.precaution: Apply least privilege, patch promptly, and audit privilege changes.
